# 🔢 version

Display the installed version of **geol**.

## 🖥️ Usage

```bash
geol version
```

## 📄 Description

Use this command to display the currently installed version of **geol**.

This command is commonly used to verify that **geol** is installed correctly or to check the currently installed version.

## 💡 Example

```bash
geol version
```
